meta.title: Rank-based auction handles tied vendor scores correctly by shifting rank numbers
gaps: Perform the conversion from a live RFQ with existing bids and observe the transition into the new auction.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Perform the conversion from a live RFQ with existing bids and observe the transition into the new auction.

plan.title: Auction starting total preserves RFQ bids

steps.note: Open the prepared converted auction's Overview screen.
Assert that the Overview shows the expected combined starting total of 200 + 240.
Assert that the Overview shows the copied RFQ quantity for the line item.
Assert that the first vendor's copied RFQ price is shown.
Assert that the second vendor's copied RFQ price is shown.
Assert that the first vendor's copied RFQ bid total is 200.
Assert that the second vendor's copied RFQ bid total is 240.
